_comment: Golden Chef Journey story text. Edit freely; src/core/story.ts validates it (tests fail if a page or recipe is missing). {name} = the chef's name. Never use he/she for the chef.

body: I'm off to see the world, so our apple stall is yours now!
I didn't leave you a cookbook. I left you my notebook of riddles instead.
Every time you grow as a chef, a new page will open. Solve its riddle and a new dish is yours.
Be kind to every customer, pick your apples well, and I'll see you soon!

pages.title: Aomori Bay
pages.riddle: Squeeze me and I'm a drink. Cut me just right and I grow two long ears. What am I?

doodle.caption: Me, trying rabbit ears. They look like cats!

pages.where: Our stall is by Aomori Bay. Wave to ASPAM, the big triangle building!

pages.title: Sweet and sticky
pages.riddle: Bubble me slowly in a pot and I spread on toast. Dip me in shiny red sugar and I'm a festival treat.

doodle.caption: A jar of jam. (I ate it all.)

postcard.text: Greetings from Norway! The fjords are SO tall. I told a ship captain called Ingrid all about your apples.

pages.title: Off to Lake Towada
pages.riddle: Hirosaki's favourite: apples tucked in golden pastry. And my breakfast: jam on crunchy bread.

postcard.text: Bonjour from Paris! Chef Amélie bakes an upside-down apple tart. I said my grandchild's pie is better!

pages.where: Time to move! Set up the stall beside Lake Towada, where the water is deep and blue.

pages.title: The red gates
pages.riddle: Layer me with cold yogurt. Bake me whole until I'm soft. Simmer me slowly until I shine.

doodle.caption: A flying fox stole my apple!

postcard.text: G'day from Queensland! Carer Mia looks after baby flying foxes. They love juicy fruit, just like you.

pages.where: Pack up! Next stop: Takayama Inari Shrine and its hill of red torii gates.

pages.title: The last page
pages.where: You found every dish, {name}. A Golden Chef! I've told the whole world about our stall, so keep an eye on the post...
